name: corgi-firestation-apron
note: PO 10-13 'Corgi sunken': the L1 fire station apron (0.75 x 1.5 m slabs at 0.40 m with 3-4 cm seams). The courier walks over the slabs and back; the corgi follows. Look for: paws on the slab top in every frame, never sunk into a seam or the apron (tests/sim/world/support-seams.test.ts guards the support query).
